channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.10'

about.description:
A free, offline statement analyser for Kenyan mobile money. It parses the
PDF statements that Safaricom (M-Pesa), Airtel Money, and T-Kash email
each month into categorised transaction data, and reports where the money
actually went.

Features a command line interface, CSV and JSON export, user-defined
categorisation rules, recurring-payment and loan detection, and an
optional Streamlit dashboard. Everything runs locally: no uploads, no
accounts, and no third-party service ever sees the statement.
about.summary: Parse M-Pesa and Airtel Money PDF statements and analyse spending

name: mobile-money-analyzer
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.2.0"

package:
  name: mobile-money-analyzer
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/m/mobile-money-analyzer/mobile_money_analyzer-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: d07b53c521fb2a1472f25efc4740fe32ee15602073755f1b43fadf898d0ac6e0

build:
  noarch: python
  number: 0
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      - mobile-money = mobile_money.cli:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - setuptools >=77
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - pandas >=2.0
    - pdfplumber >=0.11

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - mobile_money
        - mobile_money.parsers
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - script:
      - mobile-money --help

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/Ferinmtk/mobile-money-analyser
  summary: Parse M-Pesa and Airtel Money PDF statements and analyse spending
  description: |
    A free, offline statement analyser for Kenyan mobile money. It parses the
    PDF statements that Safaricom (M-Pesa), Airtel Money, and T-Kash email
    each month into categorised transaction data, and reports where the money
    actually went.

    Features a command line interface, CSV and JSON export, user-defined
    categorisation rules, recurring-payment and loan detection, and an
    optional Streamlit dashboard. Everything runs locally: no uploads, no
    accounts, and no third-party service ever sees the statement.
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  documentation: https://github.com/Ferinmtk/mobile-money-analyser#readme
  repository: https://github.com/Ferinmtk/mobile-money-analyser

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - Ferinmtk
